Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: slogan-maker
Version: 1.0.3

The slogan-maker skill is a legitimate utility for generating and evaluating advertising slogans using predefined templates and heuristic scoring. The core logic in scripts/slogan.sh is implemented using safe Bash practices, containing no network requests, file system modifications, or sensitive data access, and the documentation in SKILL.md and tips.md is strictly aligned with the tool's stated purpose.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose (a local slogan generator implemented in a shell script), requests no credentials or installs, and contains no instructions that access external systems or unrelated data.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (slogan maker) matches the included functionality. The only code file (scripts/slogan.sh) implements slogan creation, industry templates, rhyme generation, translation guidance, testing heuristics, and a classics collection — all coherent with the advertised purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs use of the slogan CLI and lists commands; it does not ask the agent to read unrelated files, environment variables, or send data externally. The script likewise only processes command-line args and prints results; it does not perform network I/O or read sensitive system paths.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no external downloads. This is an instruction-only skill with an included shell script. Nothing in the package writes or fetches code from remote URLs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The runtime script only uses positional arguments and standard shell utilities; it does not access SECRET/TOKEN/KEY env vars or other credentials.

dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request persistent system privileges or modify other skills. It runs locally when invoked and contains no self-install or autorun behavior.

dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a straightforward local slogan generator implemented as a Bash script and is coherent with its description. It does not request credentials or network access and contains no obvious data-exfiltration behavior. If you plan to install or run it, consider: 1) Inspecting scripts/slogan.sh yourself (it is short and readable) or running it in a sandbox if you have concerns; 2) Note the SKILL.md refers to a 'slogan-maker' command while the repository includes scripts/slogan.sh — ensure your environment exposes the script under the expected name or wrapper before invoking; 3) Because the source/homepage is minimal, only run it in trusted environments if you are uncomfortable executing third-party shell scripts. Overall, no red flags found.
